name: com.costbench/mcp
title: CostBench
description: Verified pricing, hidden costs, negotiation data, price changes & TCO for 3,390+ software products.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Full sourced pricing record for a software product: tiers, hidden costs, contract terms, market data, sentiment, negotiation tips, TCO scenarios, price history — every claim with its sources + a confidence/verification envelope.

slug.description: Product slug (e.g. "salesforce") or product name (e.g. "HubSpot CRM"). Near-misses return did-you-mean suggestions.

tools.name: get_hidden_costs
tools.description: The documented hidden/implementation/add-on costs of a product (uplifts, onboarding fees, overages), each with a sourced quote + date. The "what they don't tell you" answer.

slug.description: Product slug (e.g. "salesforce") or product name (e.g. "HubSpot CRM"). Near-misses return did-you-mean suggestions.

tools.name: get_negotiation_tips
tools.description: Sourced negotiation tactics for a product with success-likelihood (how to get a discount).

slug.description: Product slug (e.g. "salesforce") or product name (e.g. "HubSpot CRM"). Near-misses return did-you-mean suggestions.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Dated per-quarter snapshots of a product's pricing page. Returns observations, NOT a trend figure — CostBench does not publish one, because diffing snapshots across renamed/restructured plan lineups is ~90% measurement artifact.

slug.description: Product slug (e.g. "salesforce") or product name (e.g. "HubSpot CRM"). Near-misses return did-you-mean suggestions.

tools.name: compare_software
tools.description: Side-by-side pricing comparison of 2–4 products (starting price, enterprise tier, median annual cost, free tier, ratings).

tools.name: discover_software
tools.description: Find software products by name search or criteria (category, max price, free tier). Returns matching slugs to look up — use "query" to find the slug for a product name.

query.description: Product or vendor name to search, e.g. "hubspot"

category.description: Category slug or name, e.g. "crm" or "project management"

tools.name: calculate_tco
tools.description: Total cost of ownership for a product and team size: sourced line items (licenses with price escalation, benchmark implementation), year-one + multi-year totals, effective per-seat cost. The defensible "true cost for an N-person team" answer.

slug.description: Product slug (e.g. "salesforce") or product name (e.g. "HubSpot CRM"). Near-misses return did-you-mean suggestions.

tier.description: Tier name as listed by get_pricing (default: cheapest paid tier). An unknown tier returns the available tiers.

tools.name: estimate_llm_cost
tools.description: Estimate the cost of an LLM/API workload (input + output tokens) for a usage-priced provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock…) from its real rate card.

slug.description: Usage-priced API product, e.g. "openai-api", "claude-api", "google-gemini-api", "amazon-bedrock" (vendor names like "anthropic" also resolve)

model.description: Model id as listed on the rate card, e.g. "claude-sonnet-5-5"; an unknown model returns the available list

inputTokens.description: Input tokens for the workload (e.g. per month). At least one of inputTokens/outputTokens must be > 0.

outputTokens.description: Output tokens for the workload. At least one of inputTokens/outputTokens must be > 0.

tools.name: get_price_changes
tools.description: Recent software pricing changes CostBench detected against vendor pricing pages (increases, decreases, plan restructures) — dated, with before/after price bands and a source link. Filter by product slug, category, or lookback window. The "what changed lately" answer; each item links to the sourced record.

category.description: Only changes in this category slug, e.g. "crm"

include_suspect.description: Include moves flagged as likely extraction artifacts (unit switches, |change| > 300%). Default false.
